verdict.rationale: iTerm2's Session Restoration runs shells in long-lived server processes, so after an iTerm2 crash or upgrade it reconnects to sessions "exactly where you left off" (gh-4, gh-9, gh-19). Its tmux integration also reopens iTerm2 windows "in the same state they were in before" after a quit or lost ssh session (docs-19, docs-55). Missing for 10: evidence of restoring windows, tabs and working directories after a full system reboot rather than only an app crash or restart; explicit documentation that native (non-tmux) window/tab layouts and working directories are restored; independent or hands-on corroboration.
